description: Void a ledger entry on a settlement (it stays in history and counts for nothing). Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true and give a reason. Requires Manage finance.

confirm.description: Must be true. Only set after the user explicitly asked to void this entry.

operationId.description: Optional. Leave empty for a new action. When a previous attempt of this exact call failed with an unknown outcome, pass the operationId that attempt reported so TourPro applies it at most once.

name: void_settlement_payment
title: Void settlement payment
